subject: Constellation ISV plugin: adaptor spec and onboarding checklist

From: Alicia Gomez <alicia@constellation.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.inference>
Cc: partners@constellation.ai
Date: Mon, 27 Dec 2026 10:23:00 -0800
Subject: Constellation x Redwood — ISV plugin / LangChain + LlamaIndex adaptor

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at Constellation left excited about the performance profile and the routing/fallback model variants you showed. We'd like to explore a formal ISV integration: a Constellation plugin that makes our knowledge-graph-backed retrievals available as a LangChain/LlamaIndex connector in the Redwood ecosystem.

High-level asks from our side:
- A lightweight adaptor spec (auth, batch size, connector API) that we can implement in parallel with your SDK samples.
- Trace compatibility guidance so our observability events map into Redwood's tracing hooks.
- A mutual action plan and a preliminary timeline for a pilot (target: 6 weeks).

I've attached a short outline and an unsigned NDA for your legal team to review. Can we sync this week to align on scope and owners?

Best,
Alicia Gomez
Head of Partnerships, Constellation AI

3) Owners: Marissa (Partner Engineering) will lead the integration checklist; Kimberly (DevDX) will own the SDK samples and docs; I'll coordinate pilot success criteria and GTM artifacts.

Marissa, Kimberly — tagging you for awareness and to pick owners for the trace hooks / sample repo.

From: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.inference>

Date: Tue, 28 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Constellation x Redwood — ISV plugin / LangChain + LlamaIndex adaptor

Adding a quick internal breakout for the sync prep. Proposed internal checklist items (we can pare after the call):

- Adaptor surface area: retrieval API, batch endpoints, streaming vs non-streaming support.
- Auth matrix: API key flow + optional tenant-scoped OIDC.
- Tracing: required event types (request_id, model_variant, latency_ms, cache_hit) and recommended spans for batch operations.
- SDKs: LangChain connector (Python) + LlamaIndex connector (Py/TS). Responsibilities: Marissa -> LangChain sample + tests; Kimberly -> LlamaIndex sample + docs; Karthik -> runtime trace contract and kernel fallback checklist.
- QA/Acceptance: minimal eval set (3 prompts), perf targets (p95 < 300ms for 512 tokens), regression monitoring hooks.
- Repo & CI: create private repo under partners/redwood-constellation-plugin; include sample notebook and harness.

I'll draft the adaptor spec doc and drop a link into the call notes. Vanessa — I can take the first pass on the timeline (6 weeks pilot looks reasonable with a small integration team).

-Marissa
Senior Partner Engineer, Redwood Inference
